I speculate that the CCR2-CCR5 splice isoform will at least contain ECL2-TM7 from CCR2 (the furthest into N-terminal, the better: due to PCR length limitations); and TM1-ECL2 from CCR5 (closest to C-terminal better with the same rationale; maybe TM1-3 will not be included?)
